description_en: Retrieves the symbolicated stack for RUM
description_zh: 获取 RUM 符号化堆栈
name: GetRumSymbolicStack

parameters.help_en: The symbol file matching information, which varies based on stackType. For js, jvm, and android-native, it is a JSON string (js and jvm must contain both version and fileName, and optionally uuid/debugId; android-native supports a single module, a modules array, and il2cppMapping). For cocoa, it is a non-JSON format (module:objectKey;...) for historical compatibility only, and it is recommended to pass it through images in the new version. If matching information is missing, the symbol is not found, or parsing fails for js, an empty result is returned. If fileInfo is missing or the symbol is not found for jvm, an empty result is returned, and it falls back to the original stack only when downstream symbolication fails
parameters.help_zh: 符号文件匹配信息，按 stackType 区分：js、jvm、android-native 为 JSON 字符串（js/jvm 须同时包含 version 与 fileName，可选 uuid/debugId；android-native 支持单模块、modules 数组及 il2cppMapping）；cocoa 仅作历史兼容的非 JSON 格式（module:objectKey;...），新版推荐通过 images 传入。js 缺少匹配信息、找不到符号或解析失败时返回空结果；jvm 缺少 fileInfo 或找不到符号时返回空结果，仅下游符号化失败时回退返回原始堆栈
parameters.name: file_info

parameters.help_en: The binary image information associated with Native/Cocoa crashes. The format varies based on stackType (only electron-native uses a JSON array). For cocoa, it is a line-by-line string (each line is module:arch;uuid;loadAddress). For electron-native, it is a JSON array string (elements contain name, debug_id/debugId, or code_id/codeId, and optionally load_address/loadAddress and arch). For windows-native, it is a semicolon-separated string of debugId and debugFile (.pdb file name). For macos-native, it is a semicolon-separated string of uuid and name. If matching information is missing, the symbol file is not found, or symbolication fails, Native/Cocoa types fall back to returning the original stack lines. The following example applies only to scenarios where stackType is electron-native and cannot be directly combined with stackType=jvm in a request
parameters.help_zh: Native/Cocoa 崩溃关联的二进制镜像信息，格式随 stackType 变化（仅 electron-native 为 JSON 数组）：cocoa 为逐行字符串（每行 module:arch;uuid;loadAddress）；electron-native 为 JSON 数组字符串（元素含 name、debug_id/debugId 或 code_id/codeId，可选 load_address/loadAddress、arch）；windows-native 为分号分隔的 debugId,debugFile（.pdb 文件名）；macos-native 为分号分隔的 uuid,name。缺失匹配信息、找不到符号或符号化失败时，Native/Cocoa 类型回退返回原始堆栈 lines。下方示例仅适用于 stackType 为 electron-native 的场景，不可直接与 stackType=jvm 组合请求
parameters.name: images

parameters.help_en: The application PID. [Deprecated] The server automatically resolves this value based on the workspace and serviceId
parameters.help_zh: 应用 PID（已废弃，服务端根据 workspace 与 serviceId 自动解析）
parameters.name: pid

parameters.help_en: The service ID of the RUM application. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string. It must be used together with workspace to locate the application
parameters.help_zh: RUM 应用服务 ID。调用时必须提供，且不能为空白字符串，须与 workspace 一并用于定位应用
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en: The original exception stack content to be symbolicated. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string. If stackType is js, the format is "line,column,rows". For other types, pass the original stack text of the corresponding platform
parameters.help_zh: 待符号化还原的原始异常堆栈内容，调用时必须提供且不能为空白字符串。当 stackType 为 js 时，格式为 "line,column,rows"；其余类型按对应平台原始堆栈文本传入
parameters.name: stack

parameters.help_en: The stack type. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string. Valid values: js, jvm, android-native, cocoa, electron-native, windows-native, and macos-native
parameters.help_zh: 堆栈类型，调用时必须提供且不能为空白字符串。取值：js、jvm、android-native、cocoa、electron-native、windows-native、macos-native
parameters.name: stack_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the exception thread
parameters.name: thread_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the workspace to which the RUM application belongs. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string. It must be used together with serviceId to locate the application
parameters.help_zh: RUM 应用所属的工作空间名称。调用时必须提供，且不能为空白字符串，须与 serviceId 一并用于定位应用
parameters.name: workspace
